mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, conditions at Verona Community Park are clear and 80 degrees. Under a waning crescent moon, we expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with rain moving in later tonight.

The city is busy keeping things running, from providing engineering updates via AECOM to offering seasonal jobs at the Recreation Department. Additionally, residents can apply for a rain barrel rebate to help manage stormwater.

It is a busy day with the Dane County Farmer's Market happening today, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, don't miss the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In our weekly police report, on Thursday July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for an O W I, alongside citations for suspended registration.
Enjoy the Andes Mint Avalanche at Culver's of Verona today; they are open until 10:30 PM, so you still have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
